topic: Hampson, Song, Deadwyler & Berger (2018) Closed-Loop Hippocampal Memory Bridge (+37% Short-Term & +35% Delayed Recall, Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: 2018 Wake Forest bedside trial where personalized hippocampal timing pulses boost delayed match-to-sample recall by 37% and 75-minute recognition by 35%, while scrambled control pulses yield 0%.
